metadata.name: [SRE] K8s container status reason OOMKilled
metadata.description: P1: k8s.container.status.reason == OOMKilled (requires OTel Wave 0 enablement). May return no breaches until collectors are rolled.

breach.query:
FROM metrics-k8sclusterreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `metrics.k8s.container.status.reason` > 0
| WHERE attributes.`k8s.container.status.reason` == "OOMKilled"
    OR `attributes.k8s.container.status.reason` == "OOMKilled"
| STATS oom_containers = SUM(`metrics.k8s.container.status.reason`),
        pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(`resource.attributes.k8s.pod.name`)
    BY `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`
| WHERE oom_containers > 0
| KEEP `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`,
       oom_containers,
       pods
